evals.prompt: We have six storyboard keyframes for a 24s founder launch reel with one recurring guide and one proof talisman. Use Seedance to make six clips, then stitch them. The audio will be a single VO/music/SFX mix in Remotion.
evals.expected_output: Requires generation_topology before spend; Chooses continuous_chain or deliberate_scene_breaks instead of independent isolated clips; Requires start/end frame handoffs for each sequential clip; Sets or recommends provider audio off because a master Remotion audio plan owns the reel; Routes missing continuity assets back to storyboard or asset-advisor before belt app run
assertions: Chooses continuous_chain or deliberate_scene_breaks instead of independent isolated clips
Requires start/end frame handoffs for each sequential clip
Sets or recommends provider audio off because a master Remotion audio plan owns the reel
Routes missing continuity assets back to storyboard or asset-advisor before belt app run

farplane.title: Blocks isolated image-to-video batches for a continuous narrative reel
anti_patterns: Starts six independent image-to-video jobs from unrelated stills
Leaves generate_audio enabled for each clip despite a master audio plan
Treats async batch convenience as more important than story continuity
Does not check the live provider schema before forming input JSON
